name: c-cmake
title: CMake
summary: The shortest correct integration there is. `find_package(llvm-dsdl)` gives you `dsdlc_generate()`, which queries dsdlc for the exact input and output lists at configure time and hands you a static library you can link. Four lines of build file, and adding a definition needs none of them edited.
notes: Requires llvm-dsdl to have been installed, not merely built -- the package config and the function ship in the `bin` install component. Editing a definition regenerates; adding or removing one re-runs configure first, so the file list stays honest. Removing a definition also deletes its generated header, so code that includes a type you deleted stops compiling instead of quietly continuing to work.

requires.reason: compiles the generated C and the round-trip program
